name: mirage
text:
Released v1.0.47 with DV4: the engine's bid desk and live lane now also read Novig's own open positions every 20 s (hand bets and fills the engine's ledger never saw) and count them in the repeat guard, beside the ledger, which is also written out when a job ends cleanly. So a restart forgets nothing. Tested, full suite green.
